title: Import Resume Route Permission Consistency

items.action: hydrate the existing import batch before resuming the wizard
resume and modify an existing import batch

migration.reason: Existing Core permission codes are reused.

backend.reason: Backend authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; the frontend route guard is aligned with the existing import-batch read dependency.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: Route authorization does not create auditable business mutations.

forms.reason: The import wizard form and mutation permissions are unchanged.

notes: The resume route mounts ImportWizardPage with resumeBatchId, which must call GET /imports/{batch_id} before the wizard can continue. That endpoint requires fair_crm.imports.read, while subsequent resume mutations require fair_crm.imports.update. The direct route therefore requires both permissions. Backend authorization and action-level execute permissions are unchanged.
